worldcombat.skill.wish.summary: Sends a wish star high up; it falls back after a delay and restores half of the caster's maximum health. With Sharing on, friendly combatants inside the ring are healed by a diluted share. The star exists on its own, so it still lands where it was cast even if the caster leaves.
worldcombat.skill.wish.use.0: Lay down a delayed heal in advance
worldcombat.skill.wish.description.0: The wish star lands %1$s after it is sent, restoring %2$s of the caster's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.wish.description.1: The landing ring is %1$s blocks wide; with Sharing on, every friendly combatant inside is healed for %2$s of its maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.wish.stance.share: Sharing wish: the star heals the caster and allies inside the ring, each for %1$s of their maximum health (the caster's own share is diluted).
worldcombat.skill.wish.stance.self: Selfish wish: the star pays out only to the caster at the full fraction and heals no ally.
worldcombat.skill.wish.timing: A self move; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.wish.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.wish.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
On: the star heals the caster and allies inside the ring, but every beneficiary gets only 60 percent of the fraction. Off: only the caster is healed, at the full fraction.
worldcombat.skill.wish.preference.ai.hea: Below this health ratio the companion sends the wish early; lower endures longer, higher spends a delayed heal at the first wound.
